textBlocks.text: COLOR WORKSHOP KIT / ONE COMPLETE SET PER PLAYER

Carry souls through one night on the river. Fulfill eight wishes in four trips and survive the final return. The rules, cards and browser version are v0.5. Do not mix earlier-version pieces into this kit.
Send this whole PDF to the printer

Print all 16 pages on A4, color, single-sided, at actual size / 100%. Turn off fit-to-page and booklet printing. Use opaque 180-250 gsm cardstock for pages 8-15 and the markers on page 16, or mount ordinary paper to opaque card. Blank backs are intentional. Do not duplex.

Page 2: one-page player guide. Pages 3-5: complete rules and example. Pages 6-7: river dashboard and boat mat. Page 16 below the cut line: optional workshop record. The separate Player Guide PDF repeats page 2 for extra copies.

Pages 8-10: 14 Soul cards and 4 table labels. Pages 11-12: 10 Routes and 2 reminder cards. Page 13: 13 Memories. Page 14: 12 Arrival tickets. Page 15: 4 Events and 2 reference cards. Page 16: 6 markers. Cut on each outer rectangle; trim square corners. No folding or aligned backs are required.

Dashboard on the left, boat mat in the middle, waiting Soul cards on the right. Keep face-up Soul and Memory reserves above them. Shuffle Arrivals, Routes and Events separately, face down. Keep distinct Route discard, spent Memory, delivered Soul and Wraith areas. Use the cut-out labels. Bring a pencil and eraser for deadlines.
Check this line measures exactly 50 mm after printing.
SINGLE PLAYER / 20-30 MINUTE TARGET / KEEP BESIDE THE BOAT

One player. Finish 4 trips with at least 8 fulfilled wishes. Survive the final return. An empty shore and supply after a return ends the night early at the same target. Lose if a move costs more light than you have. Zero survives. Target: 20-30 minutes, untested with humans.

Start with light 5/6, trip 1, tide 0, no memories or Wraiths. Shuffle Arrivals, Routes and Events separately. Draw Arrivals until at least 5 souls wait; a pair may make 6. Write each deadline: tide +5, or +3 for Fool. Reveal 2 Routes.
Choose passengers within 4 seats; Achilles takes 2. Board at least one. Passenger cards stay visible. You may change the load before departure. Read the two Routes before deciding.

Choose a revealed Route. Optional: spend one memory, once only. Restore its light or change its target deadline first. Fog = route base + pressure + Wraiths + rival pair + Event - memory shield (minimum 0). Pay Killer's 1 light separately, then fog. If you cannot pay, lose. Discard both offered Routes; reshuffle discards when the pile runs out.

After surviving, advance tide and boat move by 1. Any waiting deadline now reached becomes a Wraith, affecting the next move. At ordinary stops, deliver any passengers. Each matching wish scores 1 and earns that soul's memory; gain only 1 light total per stop with matches. Keep at most 3 memories. Unmatched deliveries give nothing.

After delivery, tainted passengers still aboard on move 2 become Ship Wraiths. All others still aboard on move 3 do so. Each Wraith adds 1 fog on later moves. Draw 2 new Routes if passengers remain. At 3 boat moves, return is the only next move.

Return only with an empty boat. Return base fog is 0; pressure and Wraiths still apply. You may spend one memory. Advance tide and resolve due waiting souls; no free recovery. Begin the next trip, refill the shore and reset boat moves. Reveal an Event before refill on trips 2 and 4. Pressure: +0 on trips 1-2; +1 on trips 3-4.

Haven: no delivery; +1 light after paying, but clocks and Ship Wraiths still apply. Sanctuary: any wishes match; no light or memories, then retire its Route. Mother + Child matched together earn Passage once: before a move, send one waiting soul directly to its wish for 1 score only. Full details and an example follow in the kit.

Strictly one player. Finish four trips with at least eight fulfilled wishes and survive the final return. If no souls remain at the shore or in the arrival supply after a survived return, the night ends early with the same eight-wish requirement. Target duration is 20-30 minutes; it has not been measured with humans. Start light at 5 (maximum 6), trip at 1, tide at 0, wishes at 0 and boat moves at 0. No memories, Wraiths or Passage. Shuffle the 12 Arrival tickets, 10 Routes and 4 Events separately, face down. Keep the 14 Soul cards and 13 Memory cards in face-up reserves. Draw Arrival tickets until at least five souls wait or the supply is empty. A pair can bring the shore to six. Move the named Soul cards to the shore and write a waiting deadline on each: current tide +5, or +3 for Fool. Used Arrival tickets never return. Reveal two Route cards before boarding.

Choose at least one waiting soul within four seats. Achilles takes two seats; all others take one. Narrow Channel reduces the boat to three seats for that trip. Boarding and unboarding are free and reversible before the first move; retain each soul's original waiting deadline. No boarding happens away from shore. Soul cards remain visible in both media. Choose one of the two Routes. Both offered Routes are discarded after the crossing, except a chosen Sanctuary is retired permanently. After a stop, reveal two new Routes only if passengers remain. Whenever the Route pile runs out while dealing, shuffle its discard pile and finish the two-card offer. Unchosen Sanctuary stays in circulation. Revisiting a named destination is allowed if its Route appears again. With an empty boat, return is mandatory as the next move; no more outward detours.

Before any move, including return, optionally play one earned Memory. It has only its printed effect and is removed from play after use. Light restoration happens before costs and never exceeds six. Calm adds two to one waiting soul's deadline; it does not prevent fog or change a boat timer. A fog memory reduces only fog, to a minimum of zero. Fog equals Route base + night pressure + number of existing Wraiths + one if both soldiers are aboard + event fog - memory prevention. Night pressure is zero on trips 1-2 and one on trips 3-4, including returns, Haven and Sanctuary. Killer drains one additional light before fog on every move aboard; a shield cannot block this drain. If available light is less than drain plus fog, lose immediately before advancing clocks or arriving. Exactly zero light after payment survives. Committed memories are spent even on a losing move.
Tide, anger and the last delivery chance

After a surviving move, advance the shared tide by one. A waiting soul whose written deadline is now reached becomes a Wraith. This is the paper form of +1 anger per move: only the tide marker moves, not a marker on every soul. A boarded soul ignores its waiting deadline. Advance boat moves by one on outward moves only. Then resolve delivery or Haven. After delivery, every tainted passenger still aboard on boat move two becomes a Ship Wraith. On boat move three, all remaining passengers become Ship Wraiths. The arrival is their last chance to leave. There is no fourth outward move. Normal and Ship Wraiths have the same ongoing effect: each adds one fog to every later move. Keep their Soul cards in the Wraith area; no removal action exists. Newly formed Wraiths do not increase the cost of the move just survived.
Deliveries, wishes and the hand limit

At Elysium, Asphodel, Tartarus or Styx, choose any subset of passengers, including none, to deliver in one action. All these destinations accept all souls. A wish matches only the destination printed on the Soul card. Each matched soul scores one wish and earns its corresponding Memory from the reserve, except Po Din earns no Memory. A landing with at least one matched delivery restores one light total, regardless of how many wishes matched. An unmatched delivery grants no score, light or Memory, but safely removes that passenger from the boat. Delivered souls never return. After the expiry check, if more than three memories are held, choose and permanently discard excess cards before making another move. There is no Memory draw pile or reshuffle. Unused memories persist between trips.
Haven, Sanctuary and the family quest

Haven has base fog zero. Pay all added fog and Killer drain before gaining one light, capped at six. Deliver nobody there. Tide, boat moves and passenger expiry all apply. Sanctuary has base fog zero and treats every delivered soul as matching its wish, including Achilles. It grants no light or Memories and is retired after use. Ordinary pressure and both clocks still apply. Delivering Mother and Child together in one action with both wishes matched, at Elysium or Sanctuary, unlocks Passage once. Before a later move, while boarding or choosing a route, spend Passage to send one waiting soul directly to its printed wish. Gain one wish only, with no light or Memory; no clock advances. Passage cannot target a passenger aboard, a Wraith, a delivered soul or someone who has not arrived.

The boat must be empty to return, and at least one outward move must have happened. Return is a move with base fog zero. Play at most one Memory, pay night pressure and existing Wraith fog, advance tide and resolve waiting deadlines. Do not advance boat moves or recover light. After a survived return, record a completed trip. After trip four, end and check the eight-wish target. Otherwise advance the trip and reset boat moves to zero. Clear the prior Event. On trips two and four only, reveal one Event before refilling. Its face-up text remains available. Restless Shore subtracts one from every existing waiting deadline, resolves any now-due Wraiths immediately, and does not affect new arrivals. Then refill to at least five waiting souls, allowing six for a pair, and reveal two Routes. Other Events apply only to the new trip. No game master, timer, die, unlock ledger or hidden passenger information is required.

Example: tide 2, light 4, trip 2, boat move 0. Killer and Quiet Soul C are aboard; Po Din waits with deadline 3. Choose Ashen Gate (base 1) with no Memory, no active Event and no Wraiths. Pay 1 Killer drain +1 fog, leaving light 2. Advance tide to 3 and boat moves to 1. Po Din now becomes a Wraith; it did not tax this move. Deliver Killer and Quiet Soul C to Tartarus: gain 2 wishes, their 2 Memories, and only 1 light, ending at light 3. The empty return now costs 1 Wraith fog. Reset: return all Soul and Memory cards to their reserves, restore the retired Sanctuary to Routes, collect all Arrival and Event tickets, erase deadlines, reshuffle the three random piles and reset trackers. No consumable component is required beyond erasable pencil marks.

All Soul, Memory, Route and Event effects are printed on their pieces. Keep passenger information visible. When a partner or rival has not arrived, its interaction is inactive. Pair tickets guarantee simultaneous arrival, not that the player must board both.

One tide marker replaces per-soul anger increments. One boat counter replaces individual passenger timers. Write a deadline only when a soul arrives or when a card changes that deadline. The rules can be run without a browser or a facilitator.
